title: September FOMC · No change
rationale: Both YES outcomes refer to the same scheduled September 2026 FOMC decision. Material settlement differences require a qualified comparison.
differences:
Settlement wording: Polymarket uses the upper bound of the target federal funds range and rounds a non-listed change up to the nearest 25 bps. The collected Kalshi rules specify exact mutually exclusive change buckets; they do not state that rounding convention.
Cancellation / missing statement: Kalshi resolves the maintain-rate bucket Yes if the scheduled meeting is canceled and does not occur on its scheduled date. Polymarket waits until the end date of the next scheduled meeting for a statement before falling back to No change.
Timing metadata: Polymarket reports a close of 2026-09-16 00:00 UTC; Kalshi reports 2026-09-16 17:59 UTC. These are retained as supplied and are not assumed to be the same trading deadline.
Source / contract: Both concern the September 2026 FOMC decision, but only the source text captured with each review has been compared. Polymarket names the Fed statement and upper-bound definition; the collected Kalshi market rules use hike wording (0 bps means maintain). Full venue rulebooks are outside this review.
Fees / liquidity: The displayed midpoint difference excludes fees, execution costs and slippage. Volume units differ across venues and are not summed. A related-contract difference does not establish an executable arbitrage.
reviewer_label: Codex · source-text review, not independently human-reviewed
